common.accounting: Original MSD dense arithmetic (MAC=2), actual model/loss/backward/optimizer graphs; calibration measured separately. Fixed annotation targets, validation, augmentation and I/O excluded. Host ramp arithmetic added by scheduler.
common.augmentation_policy: None, for every baseline and constraint condition; explicit user instruction.
common.calibration_policy: Training-only gradient calibration after frozen native-loss prefix; costs separately reported
common.checkpoint_retention: Verify metrics and provenance, then retire completed checkpoints
common.checkpoint_selection: Final FLOP-budget checkpoint is primary; best validation is secondary
common.constraint_geometry: Binary hippocampus; 2-step bands; original signed face edge; full-volume half-voxel SDF clipped at 8 voxels. Depth uses 2-voxel bins in an 8-voxel ROI; plane normal is array axis 0 projected off GT PC1. Source anatomical orientation and physical spacing are unavailable; no mm interpretation.
common.geometry: Source axis order retained; label-localized 64 mm field of view; no verified anatomical laterality
common.label_budget: Five training subjects of20 (25%); ten hippocampus crops; fixed across optimizer seeds and models
common.learning_rate_policy: Original model-specific LR formula, horizon fitted to the unchanged HFH update cap
common.pairing: Same initialization, seed, patient split, optimizer, native loss, LR and update allowance as archived successful HFH controls
common.precision: CUDA bfloat16 autocast, FP32 parameters/optimizer; CPU smoke tests FP32
common.preprocessing: Linear in-plane resampling to 1x2x1 mm; nonzero z-score; symmetric padding64cubed; no augmentation
common.profile_status: Inherited measured binary64cubed dense arithmetic, same architecture/loss/optimizer
